import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

# Load the data
coffee_sales = pd.read_csv('data/coffee_sales.csv')

# Convert the is_takeaway column to categorical
coffee_sales['is_takeaway'] = coffee_sales['is_takeaway'].astype('category')

# Create the visualization: Bar chart for size distribution and pie chart for takeaway status
plt.figure(figsize=(10,6))

# Bar chart for size distribution
sns.countplot(x='size', data=coffee_sales, ax=plt.gca())
plt.title('Size Distribution of Coffee Sales')
plt.xlabel('Size')
plt.ylabel('Count')
plt.xticks(rotation=45)

# Pie chart for takeaway status
takeaway_status = coffee_sales['is_takeaway'].value_counts()
plt.subplot(1, 2, 2)
plt.pie(takeaway_status, labels=['Takeaway', 'Dine-in'], autopct='%1.1f%%', colors=['blue', 'red'])
plt.title('Takeaway vs Dine-in Status')

# Layout so plots do not overlap
plt.tight_layout()

# Save the plot as output.png
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
